title: Kathmandu, Pokhara & the Himalayan Foothills
overview_paragraphs: Nepal compresses the Himalaya's scale into a trip that doesn't require technical trekking experience — Kathmandu's temple-dense old town, Pokhara's lakeside calm with the Annapurna range as backdrop, and an early-morning mountain flight that gets you eye-level with Everest without the multi-week trek.
Suited to travelers who want genuine Himalayan scenery and culture on a comfortable, non-trekking itinerary.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu
itinerary.desc: Explore Kathmandu Durbar Square, the Boudhanath Stupa, and Swayambhunath (the Monkey Temple) overlooking the valley.

itinerary.title: Pokhara
itinerary.desc: Drive or fly to Pokhara — sunrise over the Annapurna range from Sarangkot, a boat ride on Phewa Lake, and a visit to the World Peace Pagoda.

itinerary.title: Mountain Flight
itinerary.desc: An early-morning scenic mountain flight along the Himalayan range, weather permitting, with close-up views of Everest and Annapurna.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Transfer to Kathmandu for your international departure.
